checks.message: Provisional boundary is present and marked official_boundary=false / geometry_role=provisional_constraint. The gap is visible, does not block content scoring, and will trigger a full rebuild when official polygons arrive.
Three required key areas remain provisional; announced approximate areas and submitted working geometry are displayed separately, and official polygons will trigger recalculation.
Land-use polygons are derived from the same site boundary by deterministic partitioning: full coverage, zero gaps, zero overlaps, shared edges.

Known spatial metrics are recalculated from submitted geometry in EPSG:4548; program counts are derived from open-belt-program.json. 0802 totals 3,400,943.646 sqm and 0902 is explicitly not_applicable.
Every source id cited in proposal.md is registered in sources.json with type, usage and limitation; provisional sources are not upgraded to official authority.

The structured program ledger freezes 14 scenarios, six tests, eight co-design voices and nine projects with place, suggested owner, evidence and stop conditions; the proposal locates them without claiming deployment or approval.
Provisional boundary precision limits are disclosed in proposal.md, visual/index.html, sources.json, assumptions.json and this self-check.
Static offline HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies, remote tiles, scripts, fonts, iframes or tracking.

Chinese and English A3 booklets (14 pages each) and A0 boards (7 pages each) have correct page sizes, embedded text and full-page layouts. Every page was rasterized for visual review; the first three review pages now carry distinct masterplan, key-area, section and component evidence.
Proposal includes references to standards, design depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions; matrices are not self-justifying.

Original content is CC BY 4.0; the cropped Qinghuayuan photograph remains CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution, the OSM context remains ODbL 1.0, and four generated courtyard scenes plus one axonometric base are disclosed as concept imagery rather than surveyed site evidence. No remote asset, commercial map screenshot, trademark or tracking code is embedded.

Proposal, program ledger, metrics, ten bilingual technical figure pairs, four disclosed concept scenes, visual HTML, report HTML and A3/A0 drawings use the same 14 / 6 / 8 / 9 counts, 11,412,603.01 sqm site area, 3,400,943.646 sqm for 0802 and not_applicable for 0902.

A complete English proposal, rendered report, offline visual, ten text-bearing technical figure counterparts, four language-neutral concept scenes, 14-page A3 booklet and seven-board A0 set accompany the Chinese primary artifacts; evidence tags and figure order match the Chinese primary artifacts.
Thirteen concept-only portal items validate against schema/spatial.schema.json; all are provisional and contain no coordinates or bbox.
